"""Thin, read-only review of the uniquely received PR199 main job log."""
import hashlib,json,pathlib,re
from datetime import datetime,timezone
ROOT=pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
OUT=pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parent
INPUT=ROOT/'round32-PR199-main-original-intake'
G='4786c1457b47c5baf4c09d32b96048795e863111'
P='2b6e9ebf2baeb8102df72d09360700e23487f870'
R='ca10314fbc5a4ffa28ada5b7c1097c1091b48aa4'
M='d51e4d4ad298b2f883225fd847c5fe213cc53bc7'
TREE='6518a5b317683a24ded3a69b027da6a04b8c996c'
def meta(p):
 b=p.read_bytes();return dict(path=str(p),bytes=len(b),sha256=hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest(),git_blob=hashlib.sha1(b'blob '+str(len(b)).encode()+b'\0'+b).hexdigest())
files=[INPUT/n for n in ['114082031805-original-main.log','original-run.json','original-jobs.json']]+[ROOT/'round31-PR199-actual-testmerge-identity.json']
before=[meta(p) for p in files]
assert before[0]['bytes']==1088532 and before[0]['sha256']=='c08b73afefe55637d628305259ac6d0ba0c4fc9cbde6d13aa2c07c2961172901'
assert before[0]['git_blob']=='37a142e0338f21104f06931b731a9f3e21daf6ba'
run=json.loads(files[1].read_text());jobs=json.loads(files[2].read_text())['jobs']
job,=[j for j in jobs if j['id']==114082031805]
assert run['id']==job['run_id']==38008269628 and run['head_sha']==job['head_sha']==G
assert job['status']=='completed' and job['conclusion']=='success'
assert {j['name'] for j in jobs}=={'check','msrv','security'}
assert all(j['status']=='completed' and j['conclusion']=='success' for j in jobs)
assert all(s['conclusion']=='success' for s in job['steps'])
bridge=json.loads(files[3].read_text())
commit=json.loads(bridge['originals']['testmerge']['structuredContent']['content'])
assert commit['sha']==M and commit['tree']['sha']==TREE
assert [p['sha'] for p in commit['parents']]==['09d4454fa45455dc5a8bfdfec67e31bb7ed162c7',G]
assert bridge['source']==G and bridge['tree']==TREE and bridge['merge_tree_equals_candidate_G_tree'] is True
raw=files[0].read_text().splitlines()
lines=[re.sub(r'\x1b\[[0-9;]*m','',re.sub(r'^\S+Z ','',l)) for l in raw]
def exc(a,b):return [dict(line=i,text=lines[i-1]) for i in range(a,b+1)]
assert lines[167]==M and 'git log -1 --format=%H' in lines[166]
methods={
 'borrowed_projection_preserves_select_error_order_and_recovers',
 'borrowed_projection_matches_owned_bytes_for_reordered_and_duplicate_columns',
 'borrowed_projection_uses_original_value_real_encoding',
 'borrowed_projection_preserves_escaped_byte_lengths_at_row_boundaries',
}
probes={'borrowed_serialization_equal_lifetime_release_cost_probe','borrowed_serialization_release_cost_probe'}
prefix='benchmark::oracle::projection_tests::'
contexts=[]
for feature,start,end,command in [('default',1183,1262,709),('eval-http',7262,7341,7249)]:
 assert 'Running unittests src/lib.rs' in lines[start-1] and 'cc_eval-' in lines[start-1]
 assert lines[end-1].startswith('test result: ok. 68 passed; 0 failed; 7 ignored; 0 measured; 0 filtered out;')
 passed=[];ignored=[]
 for i in range(start,end):
  text=lines[i-1]
  m=re.fullmatch(r'test '+re.escape(prefix)+r'(\S+) \.\.\. (.*)',text)
  if m and m.group(1) in methods:
   assert m.group(2)=='ok';passed.append(dict(line=i,method=m.group(1),result='ok'))
  if m and m.group(1) in probes:
   assert m.group(2).startswith('ignored, explicit finite release cost observation; no timing acceptance threshold')
   ignored.append(dict(line=i,method=m.group(1),result=m.group(2)))
 assert {m['method'] for m in passed}==methods and len(passed)==4
 assert {m['method'] for m in ignored}==probes and len(ignored)==2
 contexts.append(dict(actual_cargo_feature_argument=feature,original_command=exc(command,command+1),target=exc(start,start),passed_methods=passed,ignored_cost_probes=ignored,lib_footer=exc(end,end)))
assert '--features eval-http' in lines[7248]
assert 'cargo test --workspace --all-targets --exclude cc-semantic --locked' in lines[708]
assert len([l for l in lines if any(l=='test '+prefix+m+' ... ok' for m in methods)])==8
assert len([l for l in lines if l.startswith('test '+prefix) and any(p+' ... ignored' in l for p in probes)])==4
assert not any('--ignored' in l for l in lines if l.startswith('cargo test '))
guard=[];plans=[];history=[];python_summaries=[]
for i,l in enumerate(lines,1):
 if l.startswith('{'):
  try:j=json.loads(l)
  except json.JSONDecodeError:continue
  if j.get('source_version')=='p8-completion-source-20261009-v15':guard.append(dict(line=i,result=j))
  if j.get('task_count')==192 and 'states' in j:plans.append(dict(line=i,result=j))
  if j.get('verifier_version')=='historical-integrations-v2':history.append(dict(line=i,result=j))
 if re.fullmatch(r'Ran \d+ tests? in [\d.]+s',l):
  tail=[(k+1,lines[k]) for k in range(i,min(i+4,len(lines))) if lines[k].strip()]
  python_summaries.append(dict(line=i,text=l,next_nonblank=[dict(line=k,text=s)for k,s in tail]))
assert len(guard)==1 and guard[0]['line']==6007
v=guard[0]['result'];assert v['status']=='passed' and v['product_source']==P and v['review_source']==R and v['complete_inputs']==1096
assert v['executed_previous_proof']==v['previous_source_version']=='p8-oracle-compat-source-20261008-v14'
assert len(plans)==3
assert all(p['result']==plans[0]['result'] for p in plans)
assert plans[0]['result']['status']=='passed' and plans[0]['result']['states']==dict(done=164,blocked=1,in_progress=15,todo=12)
assert len(history)==1 and history[0]['result']['status']=='passed'
assert any(x['text'].startswith('Ran 181 tests ') and any(t['text']=='OK' for t in x['next_nonblank']) for x in python_summaries)
assert [meta(p) for p in files]==before
report={
 'schema_version':1,'reviewer':'/root/pr_triage','created_at_utc':datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
 'status':'accepted_scoped_original_main_log','source_head':G,'product':P,'review':R,
 'scope':'Read-only review of root-received official metadata and original main log; no tests, CLI, product, download or artifact execution performed.',
 'independence':'Original execution is GitHub Actions. Reviewer previously authored the main oracle integration but did not execute this job; this is execution-log review, not a new nonauthor source acceptance.',
 'original_inputs':before,'input_bytes_unchanged':True,'raw_log_line_count':len(raw),
 'actual_checkout':{'commit':M,'kind':'PR test merge','raw_proof':exc(165,168),'tree':TREE,'ordered_parents':[p['sha']for p in commit['parents']],
   'whole_tree_equals_G':True,'basis':'Already retrieved official merge commit plus original root bridge; reused without API request. This is not a direct G checkout.'},
 'original_toolchain':exc(370,376),
 'main_workflow_jobs':[{k:j[k]for k in ['id','name','head_sha','status','conclusion','started_at','completed_at']}for j in jobs],
 'main_check_steps':job['steps'],
 'borrowed_correctness_executions':contexts,
 'counting_and_feature_boundary':'Four unique named correctness controls each executed twice: default workspace regression and explicit --features eval-http. Eight execution records are not eight unique tests and are not relabeled as an explicit --features semantic command.',
 'cost_probe_boundary':'Both named ignored cost probes remained ignored in both observed cc-eval lib executions. No new cost/performance evidence is granted by this ordinary CI job.',
 'source_admission':{'original_command_block':exc(5281,5289),'actual_v15_stdout':guard[0],
   'task_plan_stdout_records':plans,'source_integrity_181_tests':next(x for x in python_summaries if x['text'].startswith('Ran 181 tests ')),
   'historical_integrations_stdout':history[0],
   'boundary':'Observed passed stdout and official successful fail-on-error steps establish actual original command completion; no separate integer-exit JSON was emitted for each command. No fabricated raw per-command exit receipts.'},
 'other_python_original_summaries':python_summaries,
 'benchmark_fixture_actual_ok':[dict(line=i,text=l)for i,l in enumerate(lines,1)if l=='test tests::benchmark_fixture ... ok'],
 'checks_boundary':{'main_CI_three_jobs_success':True,'whole_PR_all_checks_success':False,
    'root_observation_not_new_poll':{'at':'2026-10-10T00:43:42Z','total':28,'success':25,'skipped':2,'running':1,'remaining_job':114082032045},
    'explanation':'Main CI, closeout and soak are separate runs. Root reports PR199 soak still running; this report does not promote the PR to all-green or grant TODO credit.'},
 'preserved_failures':{'donor_source':'f6750cad0df45af4ec2dddc456e76cc188f3a35a','closeout_run':38004132959,'failed_job':114068898390,'log_git_blob':'3efadf710a054e2beda886cdd29938639145e94b','boundary':'Donor soak success does not erase its earlier closeout failure; it is not execution of PR199.'},
 'new_performance_or_task_credit':0,
}
f=OUT/'independent-main-log-review.json';f.write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2,ensure_ascii=False)+'\n')
print(json.dumps({'status':report['status'],'report':meta(f),'correctness_unique_methods':4,'execution_contexts':['default','eval-http'],'ignored_probe_records':4,'main_workflow_jobs_success':3,'v15':v,'task_plan':plans[0]['result']},sort_keys=True))
